advisory.finding: The new CI step installs `diff-cover` via `uv pip install --quiet diff-cover` with no version pin and outside the project lockfile, so the resolved version (and its transitive dependencies) floats freely on every CI run; a malicious or breaking upstream release would execute unpinned in the Verified lane.
